observations: Black game console with a blue DualShock 4 controller.
A handwritten note is taped to the top of the console.
The console has visible scuffs and scratches on the casing.
The screen is off, so the model and software version are not visible.
The console is sitting on a wooden surface.

claims.evidence: The model is not readable in the photo.
Photo 0 shows a used console with scuffs.
No games are visible in the photo.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a hardware fault.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate the menu.

risks.risk: The internal storage capacity (500GB vs 1TB) is unknown.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the storage size.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the storage capacity.
Video of the controller being used to navigate the menu.
Photo of any games included in the sale.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
